policy: Byte estimates, output cardinality, history counts, query chunking and source retention are different controls. None is a universal peak-RSS or backend allocation guarantee.

controls.validation: Positive integer excluding Bool; non-integer keyword type errors remain possible
controls.outcome: ArgumentError before coefficient traversal, metadata copying or dense conversion in the direct matrix method
controls.limits: Full dense Float64 only; sparse inputs densify. Not RSS. Excludes symbolic graph, user metadata and caller input storage. Mechanical/snapshot adapters can allocate before reaching this method.

controls.validation: Nonnegative Integer; Bool is not explicitly excluded
controls.outcome: Unknown PropertyResult without pair output when estimate exceeds limit
controls.limits: Selection arrays already allocated. Fixed-width estimate excludes arbitrary-precision/backend payload growth and is not RSS. Unknown geometry/data can return before pair-limit validation.

controls.outcome: Unknown pair result on output refusal; mdcheck passes only max_pairs, not max_bytes
controls.limits: Not a memory setter or work deadline. RDF/coordination omit full pair output but remain quadratic traversal.

controls.default: PINNHistory stride=10, capacity=1000; PINN train history=false, log_every=10, history_capacity=1000; inference history_stride=10, history_capacity=1000
controls.outcome: Positive controls required; retains earliest entries and records truncated=true after capacity
controls.limits: No cap on optimizer/model/native solution. Component logging can add diagnostic work. History=false is not a no-storage training mode.

controls.outcome: Rolling history drops earliest record at capacity; invalid bounds throw
controls.limits: Unlike PINN/inference history, this retains later entries. Does not bound training batch or AD/optimizer state.
controls.uncertainty: No dedicated hard-maximum regression established by this audit

controls.operation: predict PINN / scientific surrogate or operator
controls.outcome: Positive size required; returns full result assembled across query chunks
controls.limits: Full output remains O(number of queries); PINN slices input and allocates Float64 output. Must use query-independent deterministic networks; not a training minibatch or global memory cap.

controls.outcome: field_errors absolute=nothing; heat_residual values=nothing when true
controls.limits: Inputs/points and metadata still retained. Deterministic private mapped reducers can reevaluate calculations; not a universal one-pass public streaming API. sampled_summary snapshots non-array public iterators once and has no memory keyword.

controls.outcome: :retained keeps/copies source through dataset policy; :descriptor stores bounded detached origin with declared omissions
controls.limits: Selected data/schema still copied. Descriptor omits source object, context, original domain, unselected labels and selector callable. Not a compression API or persistent provenance hash.

other_limits_not_byte_budgets.controls: Fixed dimensions 1..32; bounds/grid/iterations and internal 50000 Cartesian seeds
Public maxiters default100000; saveat fixed grid ceiling1000000, while adaptive history still retained
Surrogate maxiters required1..100000; learned dynamics default100 with range1..10000; PINN/inference require positive maxiters

maintainer_only.scope: Example harness estimates/cooperative limits; not package public API

maintainer_only.control: ControlledModes.partial_chain and native SciML storage/ensemble examples
maintainer_only.scope: Specific maintainer experiments; no generic AML partial Hessian/eigensolver or scalable public trajectory inferred
